## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage5 strategy attempts to capture short-term mean-reversion or momentum spikes using volume and volatility filters, with tight profit targets and stops. The edge may exist in intraday reversals during high-volume periods, but the current parameter set underperforms on J's winner days while overperforming on loser days, suggesting a mismatch with the structural bearish rejection setup.

## Mechanism

Entries are triggered when volume ratio exceeds 1.2, likely combined with other undisclosed filters (e.g., price action, indicators). Exits occur at 75% profit target, 35% stop loss, or 12-minute time stop, whichever comes first. A chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of premium to trail the stop. Trades are taken at strike_offset=2 (interpreted as 2 strikes OTM for puts based on context).
